tool.name: nf-core ectyper
tool.description: In silico prediction of E. coli serotype
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ if [ "$is_compressed" == "true" ]; then gzip -c -d $fasta > $fasta_name fi
ectyper \\ $args \\ --cores $task.cpus \\ --output ./ \\ --input $fasta_name
mv output.tsv ${prefix}.tsv
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": ectyper: \$(echo \$(ectyper --version 2>&1) | sed 's/.*ectyper //; s/ .*\$//') END_VERSIONS ]]>
